description: Indicative construction budget (EUR) for a custom exhibition stand in Europe, derived from the public range of 300–800 €/sqm by placing the project in a tier (essential / standard / premium) based on stand type, scope and cost drivers. Excludes space rental, venue services (power, rigging points, cleaning), design fee and VAT. Use it to give a user a realistic ballpark before request_quote; always say it is indicative and that a person confirms every quote. Project fit: custom stands 16 to ~400 sqm (double-deck possible); stands built entirely from modular systems (Octanorm, Maxima, bMatrix) are not taken; smaller stands only as part of a larger contract or for a complex build.

led_wall.description: LED wall or large video screens

scope.description: fabrication_only = build in the workshop, client handles transport and crew; turn_key = incl. design

stand_type.description: Open sides: row = 1, corner = 2, peninsula = 3, island = 4

name: estimate_stand_budget
